poc_scope: 7-day Dedicated POC: reserved pool (2x A10G equivalent), production canary 10% traffic routed to Dedicated; workload: in-app assistant + support-agent; measurements: p50/p95 latency, token-cost/unit, correctness on 500 eval prompts, KV/prefix cache warm-up behavior; goal: demonstrate 15-25% cost/unit improvement vs hosted with <300ms p95 for 512-token chat
canary_plan: Day 0: Provision Dedicated pool in us-east with same model family as hosted (quantized variant)
Day 1: Run synthetic load + smoke tests (latency, throughput, cache hit rate)
Day 2-3: Ramp real traffic 1% -> 5% -> 10% (split by route)
Day 4-6: Stabilize at 10%; collect model-quality metrics (eval prompt set) and cost telemetry
Day 7: Review results with engineering + product; decision gate for broader rollout
fallback_routing: Primary: Dedicated (us-east) with quantized model variant v1-q4
Fallback-1: Redwood hosted-api us-east (same model family) — automatic when Dedicated latency > 600ms or error rate > 3%
Fallback-2: Dedicated replica in eu-west (if regional outage) — route with weighted failover
Model-variant fallback: if quality regressions detected (BLEU/embedding-sim threshold drop), automatically route to higher-fidelity variant v1-fp16 in hosted until rollback completed
Rollback trigger: sustained p95 > 500ms for 5 consecutive minutes OR quality alert on evaluation set (drop > 4% accuracy)
sla_targets: Target: p50 <150ms, p95 <300ms for typical 512-token chat; availability goal 99.9% for canary window; throughput target 500 reqs/s during peak (batching applied)
pricing_notes: Proposed: committed 1200 GPU hours/mo (reserved) at 12% discount; POC billback: pro-rated reserved fee + metered token usage; request for cap on overage during POC; finance asked for monthly invoicing; next pricing revision scheduled after POC results
